'''Mining Outpost 11''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] station established in [[the Graveyard]] in the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was commanded by [[Kathos Loof]].
